_meta.title: Originated horizon lines — 2026-11-19 through 2026-11-22 (26 games)
_meta.generated_by: scripts/originate_horizon_cdf3a108.py (rolling window, measured HCA pin; formulas byte-identical to scripts/originate_horizon_cdf3a108.py, run by session arena/cdf3a108-nba1 on the 12:2x-12:4x UTC re-cut inputs)
_meta.window_note: Today (2026-11-19) plus the next three days. The 11/19 slate is in scope because its first tip (8:00 PM ET) is ahead of this build; the far edge is 11/22 because the brief caps origination at 3 days ahead.

model_changes_vs_previous_window.was: home_court_applied: false on every 11/16-window line (flag F-W02 inherited)
model_changes_vs_previous_window.now: hca_points = 0.09 = sigma_margin 16.714 x Phi^-1(home win rate 0.5023)
model_changes_vs_previous_window.why_not_fitted: the rate is measured from the official standings HOME/ROAD columns, so there is no free parameter

model_changes_vs_previous_window.change: total modelled as possessions x points-per-possession
model_changes_vs_previous_window.was: POSS = pace_home + pace_away - league_pace; TOTAL = the sum of two team point estimates
model_changes_vs_previous_window.why: one possession count shared by both sides makes the two team lines reconcile to a single game total; the old formula double-counted the pace gap

league_baselines.closed_league_check: pass: the two league means agree to within 0.01 points per 100 possessions

G-TOT_total_reconciles.note: a window of one league must average close to the measured league total; a unit error in the possession or points-per-possession term shows up here first (an early draft of this script was 28 points low and was caught by this gate)

flags.item: No market price exists in this repository, for any game, side or total.
flags.detail: No sportsbook feed is reachable or claimed; every published probability is model-internal and no pick is market-validated.

flags.item: No strategy has passed the validation gates.
flags.detail: Every row is MODEL OUTPUT — UNVALIDATED, zero stake. The bet surface stays gated closed (G1/G2 closed) while that is true.

flags.item: The injury edition covers 11/19–11/20 games only; 11/21–11/22 have no player rows yet.
flags.detail: Teams file by 5 p.m. local the day before, so later days cannot carry rows at this build time. Each affected row says so instead of assuming 'no injuries'.

flags.item: The injury edition's raw PDF hash is NOT measured.
flags.detail: The PDF bytes are unreachable from this sandbox (TLS handshake fails); only the text render was retrievable. The edition carries text_sha256 and a null raw_pdf_sha256 rather than an invented hash.

flags.item: Rebuilt ratings rest on an unbalanced sample (12–15 games per team).
flags.detail: GP is published beside every rating and every line; a team on 12 games and a team on 15 games are compared without adjustment, which is a real source of error until the sample grows.

flags.item: LAL and UTA ratings are one game stale (11/18 UTA 109 @ LAL 97 missing from the team-stat tables).
flags.detail: The advanced/traditional/opponent tables still show LAL 15 GP 13-2 and UTA 15 GP 2-13 while the standings show 16 GP 13-3 / 3-13. Lines for PHX@UTA (11/20) and SAC@LAL (11/20) inherit the lag; the standings are the record of record.

flags.item: Injury PDF text render has blank-matchup and garbled rows (NYK@MIN, TOR@DET 11/20).
flags.detail: Two blank-matchup rows (Kuminga, Pullin) are attributed to Minnesota by position; 11/20 rows beyond ORL@BKN are garbled in the render and recorded as NOT YET SUBMITTED. No row was invented or silently dropped.

flags.item: LAL and UTA both played back-to-back on 11/17 and 11/18.
flags.detail: The rest model reads the official finals corpus, so both teams show rest_days=0 for their next game; the flag exists so a reviewer does not mistake it for a data gap.

games.total_formula: TOTAL = POSS * (PPP_home + PPP_away), a possessions x points-per-possession total. It is NOT the average of the two team scoring averages.
